name: AI Assistant
author: Bulwark Mail Community
description: An assistant next to your mail. Ask about a message, write and rewrite, and look things up in your mail, calendar and contacts. It can also do small tasks for you. Works with an OpenAI-compatible service (OpenAI, Ollama, ...) or Anthropic. Nothing is sent until you ask.

defaultProvider.label: Default service
defaultProvider.description: Used when both services below are set up and the user hasn't picked one.

openaiBaseUrl.label: OpenAI-compatible API address
openaiBaseUrl.description: Address up to and including /v1, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://ollama:11434/v1. Leave empty to not offer it. A private address must be listed in PLUGIN_PROXY_PRIVATE_ORIGINS.

openaiKey.label: OpenAI-compatible API key
openaiKey.description: Stays on the server. For Ollama, which needs no key, enter any text (for example: ollama).

openaiModel.label: OpenAI-compatible model
openaiModel.description: For example gpt-4o-mini, or qwen2.5:7b on Ollama. Users may pick another one.

anthropicBaseUrl.label: Anthropic API address
anthropicBaseUrl.description: https://api.anthropic.com/v1, or a gateway that speaks the Messages API. Leave empty to not offer it.

anthropicModel.label: Anthropic model
anthropicModel.description: For example claude-haiku-4-5. Users may pick another one.

instructions.label: Instructions for the assistant
instructions.description: Standing instructions for everyone, added to every request: the organisation's tone, sign-offs, languages, things never to say. Users add their own in their settings.
instructions.placeholder:
For example:
Write in British English.
Sign off with "Kind regards".
Never promise delivery dates.

actions.label: Actions
actions.description: How far users may let the assistant act for them: archive, move and mark messages, add events, tasks and contacts, open replies in the composer. It never sends or deletes mail. Each user turns actions on in their settings; this is the most they can choose.

options.label: Ask first: users confirm each action
Automatic allowed: users may let it act without asking

allowUserKeys.label: Let users connect their own API key
allowUserKeys.description: Users then see a Connect button in the plugin's settings. Their key is stored encrypted on the server and replaces the keys above for them.
